entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand. Just give me the return number and the label.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?

Thank you, Jane. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. Before I process the return, I do need to ask: What specifically is the issue with the band? Are you experiencing a technical fault or is it more of a preference issue?
There's no fault. I just don't have time for this. We had a family emergency right after it arrived and it's been sitting in the box. My husband was rushed to the hospital for an unexpected surgery.
I am so sorry to hear that. I truly hope he's recovering well. Let me check the return eligibility for you right away.
Just tell me yes or no. I have to get back to things.

Yes, absolutely. I've just reviewed our policy and your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I am processing a full refund for you now. I've sent the pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Okay. Good. That's the correct email. Thank you for being quick.

Of course. And Jane, as you're one of our VIP customers, and given the circumstances, I've also added a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account. Please don't worry, it doesn't expire. It will be there if you need anything in the future. I know this sounds a bit unrelated, but a friend of mine had a similar situation before his military deployment, so I understand completely.
Oh. That's... very kind. Thank you, David. I appreciate that.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please take care.
